caption: The drawing depicts a statue of a standing human figure dressed in attire reminiscent of traditional Native American clothing. The figure is wearing a knee-length, reddish-brown tunic with green and yellow trim at the hem and sleeves, and a green sash draped across the shoulder and chest. On its head, the statue features a yellow headband with a green diamond pattern, adorned with three large, multicolored feathers—primarily green and brown. The figure's right hand holds a bundle of cigars and its left hand is positioned across the chest, grasping the green sash. The skin tone is rendered in a brownish hue. The statue stands upright on a solid, rectangular black pedestal. The background is plain and off-white with no additional elements, focusing attention entirely on the statue.
title: Cigar Store Indian
